brief: Redesign the first screen of https://www.craigslist.org/about/sites so it reads faster and feels more desirable, keeping brand and copy.

judge.reason: This is essentially the legacy page unchanged with dated map styling and dense lists that remains understandable but is neither faster nor more desirable.
